title: Form 1099-R traditional, SEP, and SIMPLE IRA code-7 fully taxable statement items, tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every ordinary distribution reported on a 2025 Form 1099-R with a traditional IRA, SEP IRA, or SIMPLE IRA indicator and normal distribution code 7 is recorded as a logical statement member with nonnegative box 1, explicit nonnegative box 2a equal to box 1, and explicit box-2b-not-determined false at the keyed horizon. This claim covers only this fully taxable IRA-family class; it says nothing about basis, rollovers, Roth distributions, early or other special treatment, non-IRA distributions, or Form 1040 line 4a completeness.
